core_identity.short_form: Blue seeks perfection through knowledge, tools, and deliberate transformation.
core_identity.summary: Blue is the mono-color expression of becoming: it treats identity as editable, knowledge as leverage, and time as the price of choosing well.
core_identity.philosophy: Blue asks what a person, system, or world could become if it paused long enough to learn, model, test, and improve.
core_identity.central_tension: Blue can make possibility precise, but it can stall in passivity, over-planning, or control that delays action.

structure.primary_anchor: perfection through knowledge and self-directed improvement
structure.non_faction_boundary: Blue is an official color philosophy and mechanical color-pie identity, not a single plane, faction, personality type, or commander recommendation list.

great_tension.gift: Blue can see the possible self before it exists.
great_tension.shadow: Blue can make readiness a room it never leaves.
great_tension.boundary: This is Vox Mana synthesis from official color philosophy, not official psychometrics.

mechanics.summary: Blue commonly plays through information advantage, reactive control, evasion, manipulation, and turning time into better options.

site_surface.short_summary: Blue believes the self and the world can be improved through knowledge, tools, and careful choice.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Blue is the question mark that learned how to build a machine.

research_limitations: Do not treat Vox Mana placement axes as official Wizards scores.
Do not promote candidate commanders without current card/legal verification.
Do not use generated runtime files as claim evidence.
Do not use the Commander format overview in place of CR 903.3/903.4 for exact eligibility or color-identity boundaries.

profile.overview: Blue is the color of knowledge, improvement, tools, and self-directed possibility.
profile.philosophy: Blue believes people are not finished objects; with time, information, and the right tools, they can become something more exact.
profile.core_tension: Blue's foresight and control can become passivity or over-optimization.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Blue commonly expresses itself through card draw, counterspells, evasion, copying, bounce, artifacts, and reactive control.
